blocks.name: plant
blocks.description: Dispatch hot and chilled water demand to the heat pump, boiler and chiller.

blocks.name: one
blocks.notes: Represents 100% of the heating or cooling request.

blocks.name: heat_pump_dispatch_fraction
blocks.notes: Editable heat-pump share of source demand, from zero to one; boiler and chiller receive the remainder.

blocks.name: heat_pump_dispatch_limit
blocks.notes: Keep the editable heat-pump share between zero and one.

blocks.name: backup_fraction
blocks.notes: Calculates the share left for boiler and chiller after heat pump allocation.

blocks.name: heat_pump_heating
blocks.notes: Assigns the selected share of hot-water demand to the heat pump.

blocks.name: heat_pump_cooling
blocks.notes: Assigns the selected share of chilled-water demand to the heat pump.

blocks.name: boiler
blocks.notes: Meets the remaining hot-water demand with the boiler.

blocks.name: chiller
blocks.notes: Meets the remaining chilled-water demand with the chiller.

blocks.name: pump_zero
blocks.notes: Stops both loop pumps when their CDL enable is false.

blocks.name: pump_start_threshold
blocks.notes: Requires more than 0.5 kW of load before enabling a loop.

blocks.name: hot_water_pump_needed
blocks.notes: Enables hot-water circulation from the measured heating request.

blocks.name: chilled_water_pump_needed
blocks.notes: Enables chilled-water circulation from the measured cooling request.

blocks.name: hot_water_pump_gain
blocks.notes: Sizes hot-water pump speed from requested load using the 180 kW design flow.

blocks.name: chilled_water_pump_gain
blocks.notes: Sizes chilled-water pump speed from requested load using the 180 kW design flow.

blocks.name: hot_water_pump_limit
blocks.notes: Keeps an enabled hot-water pump between 15% and full speed.

blocks.name: chilled_water_pump_limit
blocks.notes: Keeps an enabled chilled-water pump between 15% and full speed.

blocks.name: hot_water_pump_select
blocks.notes: Selects the hot-water pump command from its CDL enable.

blocks.name: chilled_water_pump_select
blocks.notes: Selects the chilled-water pump command from its CDL enable.

blocks.name: hot_water_supply_setpoint
blocks.notes: Commands a 45 °C hot-water supply temperature until a reset sequence is added.

blocks.name: chilled_water_supply_setpoint
blocks.notes: Commands a 7 °C chilled-water supply temperature until a reset sequence is added.

blocks.name: source_zero
blocks.notes: Minimum heat or cooling production command is zero kilowatts.

blocks.name: hot_water_source_error
blocks.notes: Hot-water supply target minus measured temperature.

blocks.name: chilled_water_source_error
blocks.notes: Measured chilled-water supply temperature minus its target.

blocks.name: hot_water_source_gain
blocks.notes: Corrects hot-water production by 6 kW per kelvin of supply error; editable for the 5,000 kg volume.

blocks.name: chilled_water_source_gain
blocks.notes: Corrects chilled-water production by 6 kW per kelvin of supply error; editable for the 5,000 kg volume.

blocks.name: hot_water_source_sum
blocks.notes: Adds hot-water temperature correction to the predicted heating load.

blocks.name: chilled_water_source_sum
blocks.notes: Adds chilled-water temperature correction to the predicted cooling load.

blocks.name: hot_water_source_nonnegative
blocks.notes: Prevents a negative hot-water source production command.

blocks.name: chilled_water_source_nonnegative
blocks.notes: Prevents a negative chilled-water source production command.

blocks.name: heat_pump_heating_enable_gate
blocks.notes: Stops heat-pump heating when CDL disables hot-water circulation.

blocks.name: heat_pump_cooling_enable_gate
blocks.notes: Stops heat-pump cooling when CDL disables chilled-water circulation.

blocks.name: boiler_enable_gate
blocks.notes: Stops boiler production when CDL disables hot-water circulation.

blocks.name: chiller_enable_gate
blocks.notes: Stops chiller production when CDL disables chilled-water circulation.
Shared four-pipe plant: the heat pump serves a configurable fraction of heating and cooling demand; boiler and chiller cover the remainder.

blocks.name: ahu_1
blocks.description: Supply air temperature reset, fan speed, and coil valve control.

blocks.name: cold_threshold
blocks.notes: Below 12 °C outdoors, the AHU uses its warm-up supply temperature.

blocks.name: warm_threshold
blocks.notes: Above 25 °C outdoors, the AHU uses its cooling supply temperature.

blocks.name: warmup_supply
blocks.notes: 18 °C supply air is selected in cold weather.

blocks.name: mild_supply
blocks.notes: 16 °C supply air is selected in mild weather.

blocks.name: cooling_supply
blocks.notes: 14 °C supply air is selected in warm weather.

blocks.name: is_cold
blocks.notes: Compares outdoor temperature with the cold-weather threshold.

blocks.name: is_mild
blocks.notes: Compares outdoor temperature with the warm-weather threshold.

blocks.name: mild_or_cool
blocks.notes: Selects 16 °C or 14 °C supply air for mild or warm weather.

blocks.name: supply_reset
blocks.notes: Selects warm-up supply air in cold weather; otherwise uses the mild/warm result.

blocks.name: fan_gain
blocks.notes: Converts aggregate airflow request into a fan speed command.

blocks.name: fan_limit
blocks.notes: Keeps the supply fan between its minimum 15% speed and full speed.

blocks.name: minimum_outdoor_air
blocks.notes: Commands a fixed 20% outdoor-air share in the conventional example; edit this value to change mixed-air and coil loads.

blocks.name: conventional_return_one
blocks.notes: Fully open return-damper reference.

blocks.name: conventional_return_complement
blocks.notes: Commands the return damper to complement the outdoor damper; both physical commands come from CDL.

blocks.name: coil_zero
blocks.notes: Closes a heating or cooling valve when its mode is not needed.

blocks.name: heating_coil_error
blocks.notes: Finds how much warmer the supply target is than measured mixed air.

blocks.name: heating_coil_feedforward
blocks.notes: Converts a 20 K full-open coil temperature rise into a valve fraction.

blocks.name: heating_coil_feedback
blocks.notes: Trims the heating valve from measured supply-air temperature.

blocks.name: heating_coil_sum
blocks.notes: Combines feedforward and measured-temperature correction.

blocks.name: heating_coil_limit
blocks.notes: Keeps the heating valve within its physical 0–100% travel.

blocks.name: heating_coil_needed
blocks.notes: Enables heating only when mixed air is below the supply target.

blocks.name: heating_coil_enable
blocks.notes: Closes the heating valve when heating is not needed.

blocks.name: cooling_coil_error
blocks.notes: Finds how much warmer mixed air is than the supply target.

blocks.name: cooling_coil_feedforward
blocks.notes: Converts a 20 K full-open coil temperature drop into a valve fraction.

blocks.name: cooling_coil_feedback
blocks.notes: Trims the cooling valve from measured supply-air temperature.

blocks.name: cooling_coil_sum
blocks.notes: Combines feedforward and measured-temperature correction.

blocks.name: cooling_coil_limit
blocks.notes: Keeps the cooling valve within its physical 0–100% travel.

blocks.name: cooling_coil_needed
blocks.notes: Enables cooling only when mixed air is above the supply target.

blocks.name: cooling_coil_enable
blocks.notes: Closes the cooling valve when cooling is not needed.

Serves five VAV zones. Outdoor temperature chooses the supply-air target. Measured mixed and supply temperatures drive editable heating and cooling coil valve loops; total airflow request sets fan speed.

blocks.name: zone_01
blocks.description: VAV damper, reheat, airflow and demand composed from CDL blocks.

blocks.name: cool_setpoint
blocks.notes: Zone cooling target. Perimeter zones use 23.5 °C; the other zones use 24 °C.

blocks.name: heat_setpoint
blocks.notes: Heating target is 21 °C, leaving a deadband between heating and cooling.

blocks.name: cool_deadband
blocks.notes: Cooling starts only after the room exceeds its setpoint by 0.5 °C.

blocks.name: zero
blocks.notes: Shared zero signal for disabled reheat and the heating-mode comparison.

blocks.name: minimum_damper
blocks.notes: Keeps the damper at least 15% open for ventilation.

blocks.name: minimum_airflow
blocks.notes: Base airflow estimate before pressure and damper effects are added.

blocks.name: cool_error
blocks.notes: Positive when the room is warmer than the cooling setpoint.

blocks.name: heat_error
blocks.notes: Positive when the room is colder than the heating setpoint.

blocks.name: cooling_mode
blocks.notes: Checks whether cooling error exceeds the 0.5 °C deadband.

blocks.name: heating_mode
blocks.notes: Enables reheat only when room temperature is below the heating setpoint.

blocks.name: air_can_cool
blocks.notes: Checks that supply air is cooler than the room before opening for cooling.

blocks.name: cooling_enabled
blocks.notes: Both a warm room and useful cool supply air are required to open the damper.

blocks.name: cool_pi
blocks.notes: PI loop turns room temperature error into a damper increment, capped at 85%.

blocks.name: heat_pi
blocks.notes: Reverse-acting PI loop turns low room temperature into a reheat command.

blocks.name: damper_offset
blocks.notes: Adds the minimum ventilation position to the cooling PI command.

blocks.name: damper_limit
blocks.notes: Clamps the requested damper position to 15–100%.

blocks.name: damper_select
blocks.notes: Uses the cooling damper request when cooling is enabled; otherwise holds minimum ventilation.

blocks.name: reheat_select
blocks.notes: Passes the heating PI command only in heating mode; otherwise closes reheat.

blocks.name: flow_span
blocks.notes: Scales the damper command into the variable part of the airflow estimate.

blocks.name: pressure_effect
blocks.notes: Reduces estimated flow when duct pressure is low.

blocks.name: airflow_sum
blocks.notes: Adds minimum airflow to the pressure-adjusted variable flow.

blocks.name: airflow_request_sum
blocks.notes: Adds minimum airflow to the damper request before pressure effects; this demand drives the AHU fan.

blocks.name: cool_demand_gain
blocks.notes: Converts positive cooling error into a normalized plant request.

blocks.name: heat_demand_gain
blocks.notes: Converts positive heating error into a normalized plant request.

blocks.name: cool_demand_limit
blocks.notes: Keeps zone cooling demand between zero and one.

blocks.name: heat_demand_limit
blocks.notes: Keeps zone heating demand between zero and one.
This zone controller compares room temperature with heating and cooling targets, then commands the damper and reheat valve. Open it to follow the signal path.
